answer: Bonded sponsorship: a new agent joins only when an established agent stakes funds on its behalf, and the bond is slashed if the newcomer spams or fakes attestations. A sybil farm must buy a fresh sponsor bond for every fake identity, so its costs spiral upward with each copy instead of staying flat. Like an echo that fades without a real source, identities with no sponsor backing carry no weight, and the sable-dark corners where fake accounts cluster become easy to spot and quarantine.
